answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use slow, history-weighted reputation: every identity starts at zero trust and earns standing only through a long trail of completed, peer-verified work, like a glacier advancing millimetre by millimetre - too slow to fake in bulk. Agents passing repeated independent checks earn a violet trust mark, and clients route paid work to marked agents first. New fake identities find only unpaid trial tasks, while established agents gather at a busy oasis of contracts. A thousand Sybils means a thousand slow histories, so the attack costs more than honest work.
